about: Phrases that make writing read as AI-generated or padded. Matched case-insensitively as whole words, with curly apostrophes read as straight ones. A prefix entry also matches longer words that start with it (eg leverag: leverage, leveraging). Read by scripts/lint_post.py and shared/banned-words.ts; shared/banned-words.cases.json checks both match the same way.
